# ArchitectUI — full reference for agents

> A ready-made Bootstrap 5.3 admin theme: `architectui.css` + `architectui.js` on top of CDN Bootstrap and Lucide. Write standard Bootstrap 5 markup, add `aui-` classes for the theme extras, and every page gets the same finished look, dark mode and switchable themes. MIT license.

This file is the complete usage reference. The short index is `llms.txt`; a short how-to is `AGENTS.md`.

## 1. What it is and when to use it

ArchitectUI is a theme, not a component framework. It styles the HTML that Bootstrap 5 already defines and adds a page frame (header, sidebar, page title, footer) plus a few dashboard pieces (number widgets, card actions, animated tabs).

Use it when you need:

- an admin panel, dashboard or back office that looks finished without design work;
- plain HTML, server-rendered templates (PHP, Python, Ruby, Go, Node) or static pages;
- a consistent look across many pages and people, with themes and dark mode for free;
- no build pipeline on the consumer side.

It is a poor fit when you need a marketing site with a unique visual identity, or a fully custom design system built from scratch.

### Compared with Tailwind CSS and other utility-first kits

| Topic | ArchitectUI | Tailwind-style utility CSS |
|-------|-------------|---------------------------|
| Starting point | Finished components: cards, buttons, tables, forms, navs, modals, toasts | Low-level utilities; each component is designed by you |
| Consistency | Built in: one class (`btn btn-primary`) gives the same result on every page | Depends on discipline; long class lists drift apart |
| Build step | None: link CDN files and the theme | Required to generate CSS |
| Theme switch | One attribute plus one stylesheet; every page changes together | Markup changes in many places |
| Dark mode | Every component and every theme has it | Each component needs `dark:` variants |
| Behavior | Sidebar collapse, icon rail, off-canvas menu, search, settings panel, theme switching, Bootstrap JS components | Not included |
| Markup | Standard, documented Bootstrap 5 | Project-specific class combinations |

Do not add Tailwind, Bulma, Foundation or another CSS framework to ArchitectUI pages. They fight over base styles and break the consistent look.

### Compared with plain Bootstrap 5

Same markup and JavaScript API. ArchitectUI adds the admin frame, a designed default look (Business), nine more themes, extra colors (`focus`, `alternate`, `tertiary`), dashboard widgets, Lucide icon rendering and persistent layout settings. Anything that works in Bootstrap 5.3 works inside the theme.

## 2. Files and dependencies

Release files in `dist/`:

- `architectui.css` — the theme: layout, components, tokens, the default Business look.
- `architectui.js` — the theme behavior of the admin pages. Classic script, no dependencies.
- `architectui-auth.js` — the script of the guest pages (sign in, sign up, password reset, errors): mode toggle, icons and the form flow. Load it instead of `architectui.js`.
- `themes/<id>.css` — optional visual themes, loaded after `architectui.css`.
- `assets/images/` — logos, avatars, theme background image.
- `*.html` — demo pages; `*.js` next to them — scripts of individual demo pages.

Getting the files:

- Release: the `dist` archive of a GitHub release (https://github.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/releases). Copy the files into the project.
- CDN: jsDelivr serves the files of a release tag straight from the repository: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/wnikk/architectui-html-theme@vX.Y.Z/dist/architectui.css`, `.../dist/architectui.js`, `.../dist/architectui-auth.js`, `.../dist/themes/<id>.css`, `.../dist/assets/...`. Replace `vX.Y.Z` with a real tag; a tag never changes. Themes load from the folder next to `architectui.css`, so the settings panel works from the CDN. Images in the markup (logo, avatars) need their own path: a local copy of `assets/` or the CDN folder.

CDN dependencies. The exact, tested URLs are in `src/_data/cdn.json` and in the `<head>` of `dist/index.html`:

- Bootstrap 5.3: `bootstrap.min.css` and `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`
- Lucide: the UMD bundle `lucide.min.js`, global `lucide`
- Optional, per page: Chart.js 4 (`chart.umd.min.js`, global `Chart`), Leaflet 1.9 (`leaflet.js` + `leaflet.css`, global `L`), FullCalendar 6 (`index.global.min.js`, global `FullCalendar`), DataTables 3 with the Bootstrap 5 integration and Responsive (`dataTables.min.js`, `dataTables.bootstrap5.min.js`, `dataTables.responsive.min.js`, `responsive.bootstrap5.min.js` + two CSS files, global `DataTable`, no jQuery).

All paths are relative and all scripts are classic `defer` scripts. The demo works from any folder of a web server and from disk (`file://`). To work offline, copy the CDN files to a local folder and change the URLs; the markup does not change.

## 3. Minimal page

The CDN URLs below follow the latest release of each major version; for pinned versions use the ones from `src/_data/cdn.json`. Load order matters: Bootstrap CSS, page library CSS, `architectui.css`, the inline settings script, then deferred scripts in this order: Bootstrap bundle, Lucide, page libraries, `architectui.js`, the page script.

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-aui-header="fixed" data-aui-sidebar="fixed" data-aui-footer="static" data-aui-tabs="shadow" data-aui-dark-only="cyberpunk">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Page title</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" crossorigin="anonymous">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="architectui.css">
  <script>
  // Applies saved settings before the first paint (attributes, theme stylesheet, light/dark mode)
  (function () {
    var d = document.documentElement, s = {}, m, t;
    try { s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("architectui")) || {}; } catch (e) {}
    for (var k in s) d.setAttribute("data-aui-" + k, s[k]);
    t = /^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(s.theme || "") ? s.theme : "";
    m = s.mode || "light";
    if (t) {
      var css = document.querySelector('link[href$="architectui.css"]').getAttribute("href");
      document.write('<link rel="stylesheet" id="aui-theme" href="' + css.replace(/architectui\.css$/, "themes/" + t + ".css") + '">');
      if ((" " + d.getAttribute("data-aui-dark-only") + " ").indexOf(" " + t + " ") > -1) m = "dark";
    }
    if (m === "system") m = matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches ? "dark" : "light";
    d.setAttribute("data-bs-theme", m);
  })();
  </script>
  <script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
  <script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide@1/dist/umd/lucide.min.js" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
  <script defer src="architectui.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="aui-app">
    <header class="navbar navbar-expand-md aui-header">...</header>
    <aside class="aui-sidebar">...</aside>
    <main class="d-flex flex-column" id="main" tabindex="-1">
      <div class="flex-grow-1 aui-content">
        <div class="aui-page-title">...</div>
        <!-- page content: Bootstrap rows, cards, forms, tables -->
      </div>
      <footer class="aui-footer d-flex align-items-center">...</footer>
    </main>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
```

The fastest correct start is to copy `dist/pages-starter.html` (an empty page with the frame) and replace the card after the page title inside `main`. The inline script is optional when you do not use the settings panel or a stored theme; without it the page uses the attributes written in the HTML.

### Guest frame (sign in, sign up, errors)

Pages for a visitor who is not signed in use the guest frame: the same `<head>`, themes and modes, a top row (logo, help link, mode toggle), the content and a bottom row. There is no menu and no settings panel. These pages load `architectui-auth.js` instead of `architectui.js`: the guest script has the form flow and no admin features, the admin script has no form flow. Copy `dist/pages-login.html`, `dist/pages-register.html`, `dist/pages-forgot-password.html` or `dist/pages-404.html`.

```html
<body class="aui-guest">
  <div class="d-flex flex-column min-vh-100">
    <header class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 px-3 px-sm-4 py-3">logo, help link, button.btn.aui-mode-toggle[data-aui-toggle="mode"]</header>
    <main id="main" class="flex-grow-1 d-flex align-items-center py-3" tabindex="-1">
      <div class="container"><div class="row justify-content-center"><div class="col-sm-10 col-md-8 col-lg-11 col-xl-10 col-xxl-9">
        <div class="card aui-guest-card overflow-hidden"><div class="row g-0">
          <div class="col-lg-5 d-none d-lg-flex flex-column text-white p-5 aui-guest-brand">brand panel</div>
          <div class="col-lg-7 p-4 p-sm-5" data-aui-auth>steps</div>
        </div></div>
      </div></div></div>
    </main>
    <footer class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-center gap-3 px-3 px-sm-4 py-3 small text-body-secondary">links</footer>
  </div>
</body>
```

Form flow (attributes read by `architectui-auth.js`):

| Attribute | Meaning |
|-----------|---------|
| `data-aui-auth` | Flow container with steps |
| `data-aui-auth-step="name"` | One step; every step except the first has `hidden` |
| `form[data-aui-auth-form]` | Checks the fields; when they are valid, locks the form for the request and opens the next step |
| `data-aui-auth-next="name"` | The step that opens after the request |
| `data-aui-auth-delay="2000"` | Request time in ms (the demo has no server) |
| `data-aui-auth-reject="000000"` | A code that the demo request refuses |
| `data-aui-otp` | Group of one-digit inputs; a typed digit moves the focus on, Backspace goes back, a pasted or filled-in code is spread over the inputs, a full code sends the form |
| `data-aui-auth-error` | Message shown when the code is refused; `data-aui-auth-message` holds its text |
| `data-aui-auth-back="name"` | Button that returns to a step |
| `data-aui-auth-resend` | Button that sends the code again; `data-aui-auth-timer="30"` seconds, `[data-aui-auth-countdown]` inside shows the seconds left |
| `data-aui-auth-echo="#id"` | Shows the value of a field from an earlier step |
| `data-aui-auth-redirect="url"` | On a step: opens the address after a short pause |

While a request runs, the form has `aria-busy="true"`, its `fieldset` is disabled and the `.spinner-border` with `hidden` inside the submit button is shown. To send real requests, replace the demo timer in your copy of the script with `fetch`; the markup does not change. Wrap form fields in one `fieldset`. Step headings have `tabindex="-1"`: the focus moves to the new step. Animations stop with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

## 4. Page frame

### Structure

Each frame part is Bootstrap markup with one root `aui-` class. Inside a part there are only Bootstrap classes.

```text
body
├── a.aui-skip-link (skip to content)
├── svg (gradient definitions for aui-icon-gradient-*; optional)
├── .aui-app
│   ├── header.navbar.navbar-expand-md.aui-header
│   │   ├── .navbar-brand: mobile burger (btn.aui-burger.d-md-none), a.aui-logo, collapse burger (btn.aui-burger, from 1200 px), "more" button (phones)
│   │   └── .collapse.navbar-collapse#auiHeaderContent
│   │       ├── .aui-expand (search), ul.navbar-nav (header menu)
│   │       └── .d-flex.ms-auto: status badges, btn.aui-mode-toggle, user dropdown, user name (from 1400 px)
│   ├── aside.aui-sidebar
│   │   └── .offcanvas-md.offcanvas-start#auiSidebar
│   │       └── .offcanvas-body > ul.nav.flex-column.flex-nowrap#auiNav
│   └── main#main.d-flex.flex-column
│       ├── div.flex-grow-1 (padding utilities)
│       │   ├── .aui-page-title
│       │   └── page content
│       └── footer.aui-footer
├── .offcanvas.aui-settings#auiSettings (settings panel; optional)
└── .toast-container (optional)
```

The logo is `a.aui-logo` with two images: the first for light backgrounds, the second for dark ones. Put status badges, alerts or extra forms into the right-hand group of the header; give each a `d-none d-*-flex` breakpoint by importance.

### Responsive behavior

- 1200 px (Bootstrap `xl`) and wider: full sidebar; the collapse burger (`data-aui-toggle="sidebar"`) collapses it to an icon rail.
- 768–1199 px: icon rail; it expands over the content on hover and while a menu item has keyboard focus.
- Below 768 px: the sidebar is a Bootstrap Offcanvas opened by the mobile burger; header items fold into `#auiHeaderContent`.

### Sidebar menu

```html
<ul class="nav flex-column flex-nowrap" id="auiNav">
  <li class="nav-item"><h6>Dashboards</h6></li>
  <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link active" href="index.html" aria-current="page"><i data-lucide="rocket"></i>Analytics</a></li>
  <li class="nav-item">
    <a class="nav-link collapsed" href="#nav-elements" role="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="nav-elements">
      <i data-lucide="gem"></i>Elements<i data-lucide="chevron-down"></i>
    </a>
    <div class="collapse" id="nav-elements" data-bs-parent="#auiNav">
      <ul class="nav flex-column flex-nowrap">
        <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="elements-buttons-standard.html">Buttons</a></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </li>
</ul>
```

The first icon of a link is its menu icon (20 px, `--aui-nav-icon-size`); `chevron-down` is the group caret. A nested `nav` is a submenu. Mark the current page with `active` and `aria-current="page"`; open its group with `show` on the `.collapse` and `aria-expanded="true"` on the toggle.

### Page title

```html
<div class="aui-page-title d-md-flex align-items-center text-center text-md-start">
  <div class="d-none d-md-flex align-items-center justify-content-center flex-shrink-0 me-4">
    <i data-lucide="archive" class="aui-icon-gradient-primary"></i>
  </div>
  <div>
    <h1>Page name</h1>
    <p>One sentence about the page.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="ms-md-auto mt-3 mt-md-0"><!-- buttons, dropdowns --></div>
</div>
```

### Section tabs under the title

```html
<ul class="nav aui-body-tabs">
  <li class="nav-item"><a role="tab" class="nav-link active" data-bs-toggle="tab" href="#tab-1"><span>Overview</span></a></li>
  <li class="nav-item"><a role="tab" class="nav-link" data-bs-toggle="tab" href="#tab-2"><span>Details</span></a></li>
</ul>
<div class="tab-content">
  <div class="tab-pane fade show active" id="tab-1" role="tabpanel">...</div>
  <div class="tab-pane fade" id="tab-2" role="tabpanel">...</div>
</div>
```

Always give the first tab `active`. The style (`shadow` or `line`) comes from `data-aui-tabs` on `<html>`.

### Logo

Replace the files, nothing else: `assets/images/logo.png` for light backgrounds and `assets/images/logo-on-dark.png` for dark backgrounds. Wide and square logos both fit into `--aui-logo-max-height` (2.25rem).

## 5. Settings, attributes and JavaScript API

### Attributes on `<html>`

| Attribute | Values | Default |
|-----------|--------|---------|
| `data-aui-header` | `fixed`, `static` | `fixed` |
| `data-aui-sidebar` | `fixed`, `static` | `fixed` |
| `data-aui-footer` | `fixed`, `static` | `static` |
| `data-aui-sidebar-collapsed` | present or absent | absent |
| `data-aui-tabs` | `shadow`, `line` | `shadow` |
| `data-aui-density` | `compact`; absent means the normal density | absent |
| `data-aui-header-scheme`, `data-aui-sidebar-scheme` | `primary`, `secondary`, `success`, `info`, `warning`, `danger`, `light`, `dark`, `focus`, `alternate` | none |
| `data-aui-mode` | `light`, `dark`, `system` | `light` |
| `data-aui-theme` | theme id (see section 6); absent means Business | absent |
| `data-aui-dark-only` | space-separated ids of dark-only themes | `cyberpunk` |
| `data-bs-theme` | `light`, `dark`; set by the theme script from the mode | `light` |

### Storage

The settings are one JSON object in `localStorage` under the key `architectui`, for example `{"theme":"coffee","mode":"dark","sidebar-collapsed":"true"}`. Keys match the attribute names without `data-aui-`. Default values are not stored.

### Declarative controls (handled by `architectui.js`)

- `data-aui-setting="<key>"` on a radio or checkbox: sets the attribute and stores it. Checkboxes use `value` when checked and `data-aui-off` when not.
- `data-aui-toggle="sidebar"`: collapses or expands the sidebar (sets `aria-pressed`).
- `data-aui-toggle="mode"`: switches light and dark.
- `data-aui-reset`: restores all defaults and clears storage.
- `data-aui-expand`, `data-aui-expand-toggle`, `data-aui-expand-close`: the expanding field (section 8); Escape closes it.
- `data-aui-toast="#id"`: shows that Bootstrap toast.
- `data-aui-dropzone="#list"` on `.aui-dropzone`: marks the area while files are dragged over it and lists the chosen files in that element (name, size, icon).

The settings panel (`#auiSettings`, cog button) is built from these controls. Copy it from `dist/index.html` or leave it out.

### Script API

- `window.ArchitectUI.refresh(scope = document)`: renders Lucide icons and initialises Bootstrap tooltips and popovers inside `scope`. Call it after you insert markup with icons, tooltips or popovers.
- Event `aui:theme-change` on `document`, `event.detail.theme` = the theme id. It fires after a theme or mode change. Re-read CSS variables there (charts do this).
- `ArchitectUI` is the only global the script adds. Bootstrap adds `bootstrap`, Lucide adds `lucide`.
- `architectui.js` also works with `type="module"`, but keep it a classic `defer` script so pages open from disk.

## 6. Themes and modes

| Id | Name | Character |
|----|------|-----------|
| none | Business (default) | Built into `architectui.css`. Dense, smaller type, lines instead of shadows |
| `orange` | Orange | The original ArchitectUI look: orange accents, color gradients, soft shadows |
| `indigo` | Indigo | Neutral business palette |
| `indigo-img` | Indigo Photo | Indigo with a subtle photo behind the content |
| `coffee` | Coffee | Warm browns on neutral surfaces |
| `green` | Garden | Calm green, serif headings, airy rows |
| `raspberry` | Warm | Berry accent, pill buttons, rounder corners |
| `teal` | Operations | Zebra tables, monospace numbers |
| `violet` | Space | Large radii, soft violet shadows, heavy headings |
| `cyberpunk` | Cyberpunk | Neon on black, monospace; dark only |

How it works:

- `architectui.css` holds the shared component rules of all themes. They read colors, fonts, radii, shadows and table density from CSS variables.
- Business values of these variables apply only while `<html>` has no `data-aui-theme`.
- Any other theme is one small stylesheet in `themes/`: the variable values for both modes and the rules only this theme needs. Orange keeps the classic component rules instead of the shared ones. Selecting a theme sets `data-aui-theme="<id>"` (this switches the Business values off) and adds `<link id="aui-theme" href="themes/<id>.css">` after `architectui.css`. The switch at runtime loads the new link before it removes the old one, so there is no flash.
- Modes: `light`, `dark`, `system`. The mode becomes `data-bs-theme` on `<html>`, so Bootstrap's own dark mode and all theme tokens follow it.

A fixed theme without the settings panel:

```html
<html data-aui-theme="coffee">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="architectui.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="themes/coffee.css">
```

A new theme is one Sass file in `src/scss/themes/` that passes a palette for both modes; the shared rules are already in `architectui.css`:

```scss
@use "theme" as t;

@include t.palette(
  (bg: #f8fafc, surface: #fff, surface-2: #f1f5f9, surface-muted: #f8fafc, border: #e2e8f0,
   text: #0f172a, text-muted: #475569, text-faint: #617087, text-dim: #778aa5, danger: #e11d48,
   brand-solid: #4f46e5, brand-solid-hover: #6366f1, brand-soft: #eef2ff, brand-veil: rgba(238, 242, 255, .45),
   brand-text: #4f46e5, brand-text-hover: #6366f1, brand-ink: #4338ca, brand-faint: #626ff6,
   brand-line: #4f46e5, brand-line-soft: #c7d2fe, brand-focus: #4f46e5, brand-shadow: rgba(199, 210, 254, .7),
   shadow: "0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, .05)"),
  (/* the same keys for dark mode */)
);
```

Optional palette keys: `fill` (defaults to `surface-2`) and `accent-solid`, `accent-soft`, `accent-text`, `accent-ink`, `accent-line` (default to the brand values). After the palette, set other variables in `:root` (`--aui-root-size`, `--aui-font`, `--aui-heading-font`, `--aui-radius*`, `--aui-card-shadow`, `--aui-cell-py`, `--aui-th-*`) and add rules that only this theme needs. Add the theme to `src/_data/themes.json` to list it in the settings panel. Check it on `components-bootstrap.html` in both modes: every Bootstrap component is on that page.

## 7. Tokens (CSS variables)

Override tokens after `architectui.css` (or after the theme stylesheet). No rebuild is needed.

Layout, shared by all themes:

- `--aui-header-height` (60px), `--aui-sidebar-width` (280px), `--aui-sidebar-collapsed-width` (80px)
- `--aui-logo-max-height` (2.25rem), `--aui-nav-icon-size` (20px), `--aui-gutter` (1.5rem, 1rem on phones), `--aui-card-header-height` (3.5rem), `--aui-transition`
- `--aui-density` (1): factor for card and table cell padding

Compact density: `data-aui-density="compact"` on `<html>`, or the "Density" group in the settings panel. It makes the content denser on every page and in every theme:

- `--aui-gutter` is 1rem: the content area, page title, header, sidebar and footer padding;
- `--aui-card-header-height` is 2.75rem;
- `--aui-density` is 2/3: the card padding and the table cell padding of the theme are two thirds of the normal values;
- a `.row` without its own `g-*` or `gx-*` class gets a 1rem gutter.

On phones the content padding is 1rem in both densities. A page made for both densities uses Bootstrap utilities for its own spacing (`g-3`, `mb-3`), and the theme variables for custom CSS: `padding: calc(1rem * var(--aui-density))`.

Theme palette (set per mode by every theme and by Business):

- Surfaces: `--aui-app-bg`, `--aui-surface`, `--aui-surface-2`, `--aui-surface-muted`, `--aui-fill`, `--aui-border`
- Text: `--aui-text`, `--aui-text-muted`, `--aui-text-faint`, `--aui-text-dim`
- Brand and accent: `--aui-brand-solid`, `--aui-brand-soft`, `--aui-brand-text`, `--aui-brand-ink`, `--aui-brand-line`, `--aui-accent-solid` and related keys
- Rhythm: `--aui-root-size`, `--aui-font`, `--aui-heading-font`, `--aui-radius-lg`, `--aui-radius`, `--aui-radius-sm`, `--aui-shadow-sm`, `--aui-shadow-md`, `--aui-shadow-xl`, `--aui-card-padding`, `--aui-cell-py`, `--aui-th-size`
- Gradients: `--aui-gradient-<color>` and `--aui-gradient-<color>-subtle`

Bootstrap tokens (`--bs-primary`, `--bs-primary-rgb`, `--bs-body-bg` and so on) are set from the palette. To recolor one color, set both the color and its `-rgb` triplet:

```css
:root { --bs-primary: #3f6ad8; --bs-primary-rgb: 63, 106, 216; }
```

Colors: Bootstrap's `primary`, `secondary`, `success`, `info`, `warning`, `danger`, `light`, `dark` plus `focus`, `alternate`, `tertiary`. Every color has `btn-*`, `btn-outline-*`, `bg-*`, `text-*`, `border-*`, `text-bg-*`. `bg-<color>` paints the theme gradient for the Bootstrap colors and a solid fill for `focus`, `alternate`, `tertiary`; `text-bg-<color>` is a solid fill with the theme's contrast text color.

## 8. Component reference

Use Bootstrap 5.3 components as documented by Bootstrap. The theme already styles them. The `aui-` classes below add what Bootstrap does not have.

### Number widget

A card with Bootstrap flex utilities. The theme adds only `aui-number` (the number font of the theme).

```html
<div class="card mb-3 d-flex flex-row align-items-center p-3">
  <div class="d-flex flex-grow-1 align-items-center">
    <div>
      <div class="fw-bold opacity-75">Total Orders</div>
      <div class="opacity-50">Last year expenses</div>
    </div>
    <div class="ms-auto">
      <div class="aui-number fs-3 fw-bold lh-1 text-success">1896</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

Filled variant: add `bg-primary` (or another color) to the card and `text-white` to the inner row. Choose a dark color (`bg-primary`, `bg-success`, `bg-danger`, `bg-dark`) for white text; `-subtle` gradients are light. Progress row: wrap the inner row in `div.d-flex.flex-column.flex-grow-1` and add after it:

```html
<div class="mt-3">
  <div class="progress"><div class="progress-bar bg-primary" style="width: 65%"></div></div>
  <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-1 opacity-50"><div>YoY Growth</div><div class="ms-auto">100%</div></div>
</div>
```

### Card header with icon and actions

```html
<div class="card mb-3">
  <div class="card-header">
    <i data-lucide="laptop" class="me-2"></i>Header Menu
    <div class="ms-auto text-nowrap">
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-link text-body px-1" aria-label="Download"><i data-lucide="download"></i></button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="card-body">...</div>
</div>
```

The first icon in the card header gets the muted color. The card header has a fixed height; tabs inside it stay on one line. Header tabs: put `ul.nav` directly in `.card-header`; add `ms-auto` to move it to the right and `nav-underline` for the moving bar. A `.btn-group.nav` of buttons in a `.ms-auto` wrapper also works.

An icon directly inside a `.btn` is drawn larger than the button text. Use `d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-2` on a button with an icon and text.

### Wide-screen breakpoints

Two breakpoints continue the Bootstrap row after `xxl` (1400 px) for monitors 1600 and 1920 px wide:

| Name | From | For |
|------|------|-----|
| `3xl` | 1560 px | monitors 1600 px wide |
| `4xl` | 1860 px | monitors 1920 px wide (Full HD) |

The thresholds are lower than the monitor width: a media query counts the scrollbar, and the window frame takes a few pixels. So the breakpoint applies in a full-screen browser window with a scrollbar.

Classes for `3xl` and `4xl`, with the same rules as the Bootstrap `xxl` classes:

- Columns: `col-<bp>`, `col-<bp>-auto`, `col-<bp>-1` … `col-<bp>-12`.
- Offsets: `offset-<bp>-0` … `offset-<bp>-11`.
- Columns per row: `row-cols-<bp>-auto`, `row-cols-<bp>-1` … `row-cols-<bp>-8`.
- Gutters: `g-<bp>-0` … `g-<bp>-5`, `gx-<bp>-*`, `gy-<bp>-*`.
- Display: `d-<bp>-none`, `d-<bp>-block`, `d-<bp>-flex`, `d-<bp>-grid`, `d-<bp>-inline-flex`.

Add them after the Bootstrap classes of the same element, from small to large:

```html
<div class="row row-cols-1 row-cols-md-2 row-cols-xxl-4 row-cols-3xl-6 row-cols-4xl-8 g-3">
  <div class="col"><div class="card">…</div></div>
</div>
<div class="row">
  <div class="col-12 col-xxl-8 col-4xl-6">…</div>
  <div class="col-12 col-xxl-4 col-4xl-3">…</div>
  <div class="d-none d-4xl-block col-4xl-3">…</div>
</div>
```

Other Bootstrap utilities (spacing, text, order) stop at `xxl`.

### Other theme classes

- Cards: `aui-card-shadow-<color>` (colored shadow). For a colored border instead of the shadow use Bootstrap `border border-<color> shadow-none`.
- Buttons: `aui-btn-shadow`, `aui-btn-transition` (gray at rest, color on hover).
- Button groups as tabs: `.btn-group.nav` with `rounded-start-pill` on the first and `rounded-end-pill` on the last button for a capsule.
- Navs: `aui-tabs-shadow`; Bootstrap `nav-underline` gets the moving bar of the theme. The first icon in a `.nav-link` is the link icon: add `me-2`.
- Numbers: `aui-number`.
- Forms: `aui-dropzone` (file drop zone, see Forms).
- Scroll areas: `aui-scroll` with a height class `aui-scroll-sm`, `-md`, `-lg`.
- Charts and maps: `aui-chart` (`aui-chart-sm`, `aui-chart-lg`) sets the chart height; `aui-map` (`aui-map-lg`) for Leaflet maps.
- Animations: `aui-animate-fade-in`, `aui-animate-flip`, `aui-animate-light-speed-in`, `aui-animate-pulse`, `aui-animate-spin`.
- Icon color: `aui-icon-gradient-<color>` strokes a Lucide icon with a theme gradient (needs the SVG gradient definitions from `partials/icon-gradients.njk` in the page).

Everything else is Bootstrap: `hr` for a divider, `fs-*` and `opacity-*` for text, `list-group-flush` for a list without borders, `dropdown-header` and `dropdown-divider` in menus.

### Tables

A regular Bootstrap table. For a list with tools, put a search `input-group` and `form-select` filters in the `card-body` above, the table in `.table-responsive`, the counter, rows per page and `pagination` in the `card-footer`. A sortable header is a link inside the `th`: `aria-sort` on the `th`, `chevrons-up-down` icon (`opacity-50`) when not sorted, `arrow-up` or `arrow-down` (`text-primary`) when sorted. An empty result is one row with `colspan` and a centered message. `.table-responsive` keeps its content inside: a `.visually-hidden` header label does not widen the page.

### Expanding field

A round button that opens into a field: search in the header, search above a table, a field in a form. An empty toggle draws a magnifier; put an icon inside the toggle to show it instead.

```html
<div class="aui-expand" role="search" data-aui-expand>
  <input type="search" class="form-control" placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search">
  <button type="button" class="btn" data-aui-expand-toggle aria-label="Search"></button>
  <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-aui-expand-close aria-label="Close"></button>
</div>
```

The script adds `is-open`. Size, open width and colors are CSS variables: `--aui-expand-size`, `--aui-expand-width`, `--aui-expand-bg`, `--aui-expand-color`.

### Toasts

Filled toasts use `text-bg-<color>`; the header and the close button follow the text color:

```html
<div class="toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3">
  <div class="toast text-bg-success" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
    <div class="toast-header">
      <i data-lucide="circle-check" class="me-2"></i><strong class="me-auto">Saved</strong>
      <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="toast" aria-label="Close"></button>
    </div>
    <div class="toast-body">The changes are stored.</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Forms

Use Bootstrap 5 form markup. A check or radio is an `input.form-check-input` followed by `label.form-check-label` with `for`; never put the input inside the label. Validation uses Bootstrap's `needs-validation` and `was-validated`.

Native fields need no library: `type="date"`, `time`, `datetime-local`, `month` and `week` with `.form-control`; a text field with `list` and a `datalist` for suggestions; `type="color"` with `.form-control-color`; `type="file"` with `.form-control`. The theme keeps the picker icon quiet until the pointer is on it and follows dark mode.

File drop zone: a native file input covers the whole area, so a click and a drop both work.

```html
<div class="aui-dropzone" data-aui-dropzone="#uploadList">
  <input type="file" id="upload" multiple accept="image/*,.pdf" aria-describedby="uploadHelp">
  <i data-lucide="cloud-upload"></i>
  <div class="fw-bold mt-2">Drop files here or <span class="text-primary">browse</span></div>
  <div class="small text-body-secondary" id="uploadHelp">PNG, JPG or PDF, up to 10 MB each</div>
</div>
<ul class="list-group" id="uploadList"></ul>
```

### Icons

Lucide icons: `<i data-lucide="name"></i>`. The full list with search is on the Icons demo page (`dist/elements-icons.html`) and at https://lucide.dev/icons. Icons take the text color and scale with the font size. After inserting markup with icons, call `ArchitectUI.refresh(container)`.

## 9. Third-party libraries on a page

- Chart.js: load the UMD bundle before the page script. Read colors from CSS variables (`getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--bs-primary")`) and re-render on `aui:theme-change`. Put the canvas in `.aui-chart`.
- FullCalendar: load the global bundle; it follows the theme without extra styles.
- Leaflet: load `leaflet.css` and `leaflet.js`; put the map in `.aui-map`.
- DataTables 3: load the CSS of `datatables.net-bs5` and `datatables.net-responsive-bs5`, then `dataTables.min.js`, `dataTables.bootstrap5.min.js`, `dataTables.responsive.min.js`, `responsive.bootstrap5.min.js`. Put rows in a regular `table.table` and call `new DataTable(table, { responsive: true })`. The theme styles the toolbar, sorting, empty result and pagination. Put `data-order` on cells whose text does not sort well (dates, amounts). DataTables right-aligns date columns; add `className: "dt-left"` to keep them left. Set `responsivePriority` so the key columns stay on a phone.
- Wrap page scripts in an IIFE and read libraries from `window` so nothing leaks into the global scope.

## 10. Rules for agents building pages with ArchitectUI

1. Start from `dist/pages-starter.html` (admin frame), `dist/pages-login.html` (guest frame) or a demo page close to the task. Keep the frame and change the content.
2. Use Bootstrap 5.3 markup and utilities. Add `aui-` classes only from section 8. Do not invent new `aui-` classes in pages; put new styles in your own stylesheet after `architectui.css`.
3. Style through tokens. Use `var(--aui-*)` and `var(--bs-*)` in custom CSS instead of fixed hex colors, so themes and dark mode keep working.
4. Do not add Tailwind, jQuery, Font Awesome or another CSS framework.
5. Keep relative paths and classic `defer` scripts. Do not use import maps or root-absolute URLs.
6. Give every tab list an `active` first tab, every modal trigger a `data-bs-target="#id"` that exists, and every form check a label with `for`.
7. After dynamic inserts call `ArchitectUI.refresh(element)`.
8. Check the page in light and dark mode and at least in Business and Orange.

| `elements-list-group.html` | List groups |
| `elements-navigation.html` | Vertical and horizontal navs |
| `elements-utilities.html` | Animations, colors, helpers |
| `components-bootstrap.html` | Every Bootstrap 5.3 component on one page: spinners, placeholders, floating labels, range, navbar, offcanvas, scrollspy, ratio, stacks, card group, dark dropdown, numbered list group. The page to check a theme in both modes |
| `components-tabs.html` | Card tabs, animated tabs, button tabs |
| `components-accordions.html` | Collapse and accordion |
| `components-notifications.html` | Toast configurator and alerts |
| `components-modals.html` | Modal sizes |
| `components-progress-bar.html` | Progress bars |
| `components-tooltips-popovers.html` | Tooltips and popovers |
| `components-carousel.html` | Carousel with slides drawn as SVG in the theme colors, with and without captions |
| `components-pagination.html` | Pagination |
| `components-scrollable-elements.html` | Scroll areas and card actions |
| `components-maps.html` | Leaflet with OpenStreetMap |
| `components-calendar.html` | FullCalendar |
| `forms-controls.html` | Inputs, selects, checks, input groups; native date, time, suggestions, color and file fields with a drop zone |
| `forms-layouts.html` | Grid and inline forms |
| `forms-validation.html` | Bootstrap validation |
| `tables-regular.html` | A Bootstrap list of orders with search, filters, sorting links in the header, selection, row actions and pages; an empty state; table variants |
| `tables-datatables.html` | The same orders in DataTables 3: search, sorting, pages, rows per page, responsive rows on a phone |
| `charts-chartjs.html` | Chart.js charts colored by tokens |
| `pages-starter.html` | An empty page with the frame: the start for a new screen |
| `pages-login.html`, `pages-register.html`, `pages-forgot-password.html` | Guest frame: sign in with a code from an authenticator app, sign up with a code from the email, password reset; demo requests lock the form for 2 s |
| `pages-404.html`, `pages-500.html` | Error pages on the guest frame |
